policy_prompt_for_subgoal: The menu options need no target point; if a point is demanded anyway, point at the object the option names (the cube for C, D, E; the stick for A; the target for B and E would be the cube's destination, but prefer the cube). The memory holds only `method`. An episode starts at the first decision step with empty memory, fingers fully open and nothing executed yet; first fill `method` from the demonstration steps, then choose by it. At every later decision step, what is in the fingers is read from the step itself: the execution steps shown since the previous decision (descent, finger closure, rise) and the finger opening and gripper height in the scene at this step. Judge by finger opening and the rise, not by whether an object is marked as held, since the marking can be absent or unreliable. Rules, applied in whatever situation the policy stands in: - If `method` is `push`: choose C (close gripper and push the cube to the target). This is the only subgoal for a push episode. - If the fingers are now closed to about 40-60% and the gripper has risen after descending onto the cube: choose E (place the cube onto the target). - If the fingers are now closed to about 20-25% and the gripper has risen after descending onto the stick: choose B (hook the cube to the target with the peg). - Otherwise (fingers fully open, or closed to about 0% with nothing raised) choose by `method`: `pick` -> D (pick up the cube), `hook` -> A (pick up the peg), `push` -> C. If a situation has no rule: if `method` cannot be told, decide by what the scene shows - fingers partly closed with the cube raised means E, fingers closed to about 20-25% with the stick raised means B; otherwise if the demonstration showed the stick held choose A, if it showed the cube lifted choose D, and if neither choose C. Never choose E unless the step shows the fingers at about 40-60% and risen after a descent onto the cube; never choose B unless the step shows the fingers at about 20-25% and risen after a descent onto the stick.

fields.name: method
fields.description: The way the demonstration moved the cube. At the first decision step, read it from the demonstration steps: `pick` if the cube is marked as held in the gripper while the gripper is well above the table (height above about 0.08) with fingers partly closed (about 40-60% open) and the cube is then released over the target; `hook` if the stick (peg) is marked as held in the gripper with fingers closed to about 20-25% and is dragged against the cube toward the target; `push` if the fingers close to about 0% at table height (height below about 0.04) and the cube slides to the target without ever being lifted or any stick being held. At every later step copy the value carried in unchanged; never write `unknown` after the first step. e.g. hook
